question: Before the player's final challenge against the Yin Tiger (寅虎), what replacement did they make regarding Magic Treasure (法宝)?
reference_answer: Replaced Fire Shield (避火罩) with Embroidered Needle (绣花针).

rollouts.answer: Before the final 寅虎 challenge, they replaced the equipped magic treasure 辟火罩 with 绣花针. The menu briefly highlights 定风珠, but it was not equipped; the '已装备' status changes to 绣花针 at about 68824.5 seconds, just before the challenge at 68850 seconds.

Ran a targeted semantic_search for 'final challenge Yin Tiger' against event_steps and got a boss-fight-flavored hit near 69060-69090, correctly steering away from the 50160 forge scene.

Ran run_sql sweeps over 68700-69120 then narrowed to 68790-68860, surfacing topic_facts/visual_clips rows at exactly 68820 ('equipment/根器 menu: 定风珠, 绣花针') immediately followed by the 68850 boss-challenge dialogue ('快速/智谋/挑战/离开').
clip_qa on 68820-68850 visually confirmed 辟火罩 (not 定风珠) had '已装备' status before being swapped to 绣花针 -- this direction/item name is NOT present in any stored text row, only recoverable visually.

decisive_steps.what_happened: Top semantic_search hit was the same 50160 forge-NPC distractor row seen by other rollouts ('寅虎: item-upgrade interface with 威风兽面 and 青铜猴面'), but this rollout never issued a corrective search like rollout-0's 'final challenge Yin Tiger' query against event_steps.

run_sql over the CORRECT window 68000-69200 returned topic_facts row at exactly time_s=68820.0: 'equipment/根器 menu: 定风珠, 绣花针; ... approaches 翠云殿 shrine' immediately followed by the 68850.0 row describing the boss-challenge dialogue with 寅虎 (挑战 option) -- the actual clue was in hand but not pursued with clip_qa.
Instead pivoted to run_sql over 49800-50300 (the forge-NPC window) and treated that as the anchor for 'final challenge'.

clip_qa was launched only on 50060-50160 (wrong window); it correctly reported no 法宝 replacement happens there (only mask/armor browsing), and the agent trusted this negative visual result as the final answer without ever visually checking 68820-68850.

rollouts.failure_point: Wrong time-window anchoring: conflated a distractor '寅虎' NPC encounter (blacksmith/forge scene at ~50160s, with menu options 铸造/强化/挑战/离开) with the actual final boss challenge (~68850s, dialogue options 快速/智谋/挑战/离开). The correct window's SQL evidence (68820 row mentioning 定风珠, 绣花针) was retrieved but not recognized as decisive and never visually verified with clip_qa; the agent verified the wrong window instead and submitted a confident negative answer.
rollouts.evidence_checked: Verified via sql that the run_sql query the agent itself issued over 68000-69200 already contained the topic_facts row at time_s=68820.0 naming 定风珠/绣花针 next to the 68850.0 challenge-dialogue row; the agent simply did not act on it.

db_evidence.notes: The clue interval 68820-68826 is well covered by episodes/topic_facts/semantic_triples/visual_clips rows (all four tables have a row at/around 68820-68850 mentioning 定风珠 and 绣花针 in an equipment/根器 menu, followed immediately by the 寅虎 boss-challenge dialogue at 68850). However, NONE of the stored text rows mention 辟火罩 (Fire Shield) by name anywhere in this window -- it is only visible in the video frames as the item marked '已装备' before the swap. This means the question is unanswerable from text/SQL/semantic_search alone; a correctly-windowed clip_qa call is mandatory to name the 'before' item and get the reference answer right. All 4 passing rollouts used clip_qa on (or very near) 68820-68850 for exactly this purpose; the failing rollout used clip_qa on a different, wrong window (50060-50160).

root_causes: Duplicate/confusable entity name: the DB contains two distinct '寅虎'-labeled encounters -- a forge/blacksmith NPC scene at ~50160s (menu: 铸造/强化/挑战/离开) and the actual final boss battle at ~68850s (dialogue: 快速/智谋/挑战/离开). Semantic search over topic_facts/episodes surfaces the forge scene as the top-scoring hit in every rollout because its text explicitly starts with '寅虎:'.

Rollout-04 failed to issue a discriminating follow-up search (e.g. 'final challenge/boss battle' against event_steps, as rollout-0 did) to distinguish the forge NPC from the actual final challenge, so it anchored on the wrong window despite later retrieving the correct window's SQL rows.

Rollout-04 retrieved the decisive topic_facts row (time_s=68820, mentioning 定风珠/绣花针 in an equipment menu right before the 68850 boss-challenge dialogue) via its own run_sql call but did not recognize it as decisive and never launched clip_qa there; it instead trusted a clip_qa result from the wrong window as a negative answer.

The critical fact (avoided item was 辟火罩, not 定风珠) is not present in any stored text/SQL row in either window -- it exists only in video frames -- so success strictly required visually verifying the correct 68820-68850 window with clip_qa; verifying the wrong window (even correctly) produces a plausible-sounding but wrong conclusion.
what_worked: 4/5 rollouts issued a corrective/refined search step (searching event_steps or episodes specifically for 'final challenge'/boss-fight framing) that pulled them off the 50160 forge-NPC distractor and onto the correct ~68820-69090 boss-approach window.
All 4 passing rollouts narrowed with run_sql sweeps of decreasing window size around 68700-69120 before calling clip_qa, converging tightly on 68790-68860.

All 4 passing rollouts correctly used clip_qa (not just text) to determine the specific 'before' item (辟火罩), since it is absent from all stored text -- and correctly avoided misattributing the swap to 定风珠, which is only browsed/highlighted in the menu, not equipped.
transferable_lessons: When a question names an entity/location (e.g. '寅虎') that could match multiple distinct occurrences in the DB, do not accept the single highest-scoring semantic_search hit as the target -- issue a second, differently-worded query anchored on the question's other qualifiers (here: 'final challenge', 'boss battle') to disambiguate before committing to a time window.

When run_sql over a broad time window returns a row that matches the question's key nouns (item names, menu labels) very literally, treat it as a strong candidate to visually verify with clip_qa even if it wasn't the top semantic-search hit -- don't let an earlier, superficially similar hit anchor the whole investigation.

For 'state change'/replacement questions where item names might only appear visually (e.g. an item marked '已装备' with no accompanying text description), clip_qa on the exact narrowed window is mandatory, not optional -- and it must be run on every plausible candidate window before concluding a negative ('no replacement occurred') answer.

A confident visual confirmation from clip_qa on the WRONG window (correctly reporting 'no change here') should not be treated as conclusive evidence that no change occurred anywhere else in the video; before submitting a negative answer, cross-check against any other still-unverified candidate window already surfaced by earlier SQL/search steps.
open_questions: Whether the memory-build pipeline could/should disambiguate the two '寅虎' entities (forge NPC vs. final boss) at ingestion time, e.g. via distinct entity IDs, to reduce this class of confusion at retrieval time.

Why rollout-04 chose to run_sql the wrong window (49800-50300) again in more detail immediately after already having queried the correct window (68000-69200) with no apparent trigger recognizing the 68820 row as significant -- not fully resolved from tool outputs alone since reasoning text is encrypted.
